analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($683.55) vs SMA5/20/50 ($677.42/$702.25/$715.01) — Above SMA5, below SMA20/50, indicating a short-term bounce followed by entry into a medium-term resistance zone.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($673.87/$643.39) — Above long-term support, maintaining medium-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-Week Position (66.9%) + Current price level is historically mid-range, approximately 8.7% below the 52-week high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (41.9→43.2) — Exited oversold territory, now consolidating in the neutral zone, indicating a lack of directional momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-2.6864→-3.8294) — Worsening within negative territory, maintaining a bearish trend signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $702.25) — Trading around the middle band, exploring direction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($610.15) — Long-term support zone based on SMA100 ($673.87) and Pivot S1 ($652.85).
· Swing Resistance ($722.03) — Short-to-medium-term resistance zone based on SMA20 ($702.25) and Pivot R1 ($722.54); a breakout could signal a trend reversal.
· 5-Day/20-Day High/Low Pattern (5-Day High $692.63, 20-Day High $730.83 / 5-Day Low $661.14, 20-Day Low $661.14) — 5-day and 20-day lows are identical, and the 5-day high is lower than the 20-day high, indicating a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.36x) — Above-average volume accompanies recent moves, slightly increasing confidence.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) — Due to neutral RSI, worsening MACD, and SMA20 resistance, this is a phase requiring observation and trend confirmation rather than immediate entry.

keyPointsEn: RSI is neutral and sideways, showing a lack of direction, while the MACD histogram continues to worsen, indicating weakening buying pressure.
Failure to break the SMA20 ($702.25) resistance level suggests continued downward pressure dominance.
ADX at 27.2 indicates a trend, but -DI is higher than +DI, signaling downward pressure dominance, making it difficult to interpret as a trend reversal signal.
